root_cause: The new multi-context engine correctly separates business phase from strategic-event overlays, but the legacy lifecycle compatibility projection inherited the primary phase evidence mode. Explicit buy/sell/portfolio legacy lifecycle input therefore appeared as unproven in the compatibility contract even though it was explicit.
prevention_rule: Legacy lifecycle compatibility projections must preserve evidence semantics independently from the new primary business-phase axis. Explicit legacy M&A/portfolio context is always derived/evidenced even when the modern primary company phase remains unproven.

evidence.outcome: Explicit legacy M&A lifecycle context remains compatible and evidence-backed while modern business phase and strategic overlays stay separate.
